_doc: Unlearn rollout. Each phase opens only when the previous phase's exit gates are measured as met. Read by tests/foundation/test_unlearn.py; research: https://claude.ai/artifact/9tSXs9RsEVf4xi3Hr4v9kW

principles.rule: The child starts every project; no assigned tasks, quests or daily goals
principles.basis: Huizinga: play to order is no longer play; Agora self-chosen challenges

principles.rule: Help ladder: ask what was tried, then a hint, then a worked part; a full solution only on request
principles.basis: Sinha and Kapur 2021 productive failure; Bastani et al. 2024 tutor arm

principles.rule: The AI builds plumbing; the child keeps decisions, rules, art and debugging
principles.basis: Vygotsky zone of proximal development; Papert constructionism

principles.rule: Help offered drops where the child has succeeded unaided before
principles.basis: Weisberg et al. guided play; Skene et al. 2022

principles.rule: Every project shows what the child made, decided or fixed
No scores, grades, streaks, badges or time-in-app targets
A sandbox with no saving, sharing or record
Seed varied cross-domain starting points; measure variety, not template reuse
A coach or parent gets a digest with conversation prompts; the AI supports the adult and never replaces them
principles.basis: Mitra's results improved with a mediator; Arora 2010

principles.rule: No personal data in prompts, nothing public without adult consent, no companion persona, minimal and deletable data
principles.basis: COPPA amended rule, UK Children's Code, GDPR art. 8

phases.name: Coaches and parents
phases.child_data: none: the adult writes about the exploration, never the child's identity
ships: pill ask bar for logging a curiosity
coaching move generator with an answer-leak guard

phases.name: Schools and learning centres
phases.audience: Agora-style schools, coach groups of 15 to 17 children
phases.child_data: pseudonymous ids issued and held by the school, which is the data controller; Unlearn is the processor
ships: coach group view and weekly digest
DPIA covering the 15 Children's Code standards

phases.name: Kids directly
phases.audience: children building on the platform, invited by a school or parent account
phases.child_data: account created by the adult; parental consent under 16 in NL (GDPR art. 8) and under 13 in the US (COPPA, amended rule compliance date 2026-04-22); written retention policy and security program published
ships: build companion with the help ladder
peer show and remix inside a school

identity_bound_gate.what: the legal entity that is data controller for direct child accounts
identity_bound_gate.default_in_effect: phase 3 stays closed; phases 1 and 2 run, with schools as controllers
